name: blog-newsletter-cta
title: Newsletter CTA
description: Newsletter signup in three layouts (inline, sticky, split): a form on a server action with validation and a honeypot, in the project's design system; double opt-in stays with the provider

layouts.title: Inline
layouts.description: A full-width band on the sunk tint, the form under the text; the default (1.x variant inline).
layouts.usage: <NewsletterCta layout="inline" content={{ title, text, privacy }} action={subscribe} />

layouts.title: Sticky
layouts.description: A framed card that stays in view in a column taller than itself (1.x variant sticky).
layouts.usage: <NewsletterCta layout="sticky" content={{ title, text, privacy }} action={subscribe} />

layouts.title: Split
layouts.description: The band with the title and text beside the form from md, stacked on a phone.
layouts.usage: <NewsletterCta layout="split" content={{ title, text, privacy }} action={subscribe} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; layouts inline, sticky, split; default look equals 1.0.0; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two hosts; axe clean; no leak; no-JS submit; mutants caught
postMessage: Needs zod. See components/blog-newsletter-cta/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads, your server action, the German label set and the Next link wiring.
